messages:
leo: Heads up  someone ate half a croissant from the labeled shelf. Not cool to take food with tags.

hana: oh no sorry that was me, thought it was communal. i'll replace it today. my bad. :bow: 

ben: thanks hana. can we add a small sign: "LABELED = DO NOT TAKE" above the shelf? simple fix.

isabel: also request: can we get more disposable tongs for the snack jar? hands-in-jar is not a vibe. :nauseated_face:

leo: good call. kitchen-helper-bot, add tongs + small sign to shopping list.
kitchen-helper-bot: added to shopping list: "disposable tongs x20", "shelf signs (3)", "small zip bags". Reminder: reorder when below threshold.

hana: replacing croissants now. what do people prefer: butter or chocolate? i'll get 6 of each.

ben: butter please. chocolate for the moral hazard.

isabel: butter for me too. Also can someone check the condiment basket? missing honey.

leo: I put a sticky on the basket: "HONEY = ESSENTIAL" :honey_pot:

hana: quick note: microwave was left open with a container of soup last night, it spilled. i'll bring cleaning wipes. maybe add a microwave etiquette sticky: "COVER + WIPE"

ben: +1 for etiquette stickies. I can design a tiny laminated card.

isabel: small poll: pastry lockbox? i.e., labeled items get a small clip-on lid. vote: yes/no.

leo: yes

hana: yes

ben: no (makes access annoying)

isabel: majority yes. we'll try clip lids for a week.

leo: buy list I put in the notes:
```
- Disposable tongs x20
- Shelf signs (3)
- Clip lids for snack containers x10
- Honey squeeze bottle x1
- Microwave surface wipes x2 packs
```

hana: Venmo ok? I'll Venmo @hana-redwood for the croissant money.

ben: Venmo sent. receipt photo: https://files.internal/company-kitchen/receipts/1842056790.jpg

kitchen-helper-bot: reminder set: "Place sticky labels + clip lids" tomorrow 09:30 AM.

leo: thanks all. small behavior wins keep ants away and morale high. :raised_hands:
